{{Quote|Branded himself as the assassin who could kill absolutely anybody. For the right price, of course. Spent several years proving it, too.|[[Crysta Markon]], briefing the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] on his target|<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />}}
The '''Eidolon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and owner of [[Eidolon Security]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We had plenty of work for him. Killing folks ain't that hard. Anyone can kill a gank on the street, but the Eidolon specialized in impossible targets. But then, at the top of his game, the Eidolon announces he's getting out of the assassination business. Opened a security company. Suddenly, half the corporations here were clients of Eidolon Security--and were no longer paying the Hutt Cartel.|[[Gele'ren]]|<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />}}
The Eidolon became famous as one of the most skilled assassin on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], working mostly for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. However, at some point, the Eidolon retired and created a security company, [[Eidolon Security]]. The company was soon very successful and became a major provider of munitions for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, the company took over many clients of the Hutt Cartel, making the Eidolon an enemy of the Cartel.<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Eidolon was chosen as one of the targets of the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:TEoME" /> After the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] of the competition bombed his company's manufacturing facility<ref name="TOR:EB">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Economic Boom|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> and uploaded its private records on to the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] with assistance from [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Gele'ren]] and his slicer, [[Anuli]], the Eidolon was drawn out of hiding. His [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] killed Anuli after the slicer uploaded the company's records, and he informed the hunter that he would meet them if they could survive the way to his location on the moon.<ref name="TOR:IE">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Industrial Espionage|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

{{GameDS}}
After defeating the Eidolon's security forces and making their way to him, the hunter and [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] confronted him and were attacked after a short conversation. The Eidolon was defeated in combat by the hunter, who handed him over to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] as a live bounty.<ref name="TOR:PC" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Instead of handing him over to the Hutts, where a worse fate likely awaits, the player has the option of giving him a mercy killing, or giving the decision to Mako. Mako will decide to kill him if the player chooses this option.<ref name="TOR:PC" />
